| [CLAIM-690](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-690.md) v3 | Whichever way a whole and its part depend on each other, the same magnitude of dependence can run either way, and what sorts it is who controls the terms on which it is met, exit, renegotiation and the conditions of supply, while the magnitude and the integration that produced it set only how much rides on it: with the part able to withdraw or renegotiate, the whole's need of it becomes the part's hold on its terms; with the terms at an agent's discretion, the same need gives the part none, and the part's own dependence becomes vulnerability to that agent, on whom, under a principle grounding obligations in such vulnerability, the strengthened responsibility falls | The assistant's, offered at step 12 of the filing of "About Plantation Paradise" ([#488](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/488)) and accepted by the owner on 2026-11-13. | [CLAIM-1184](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1184.md) | Standing to contest a harm matters only as a means of preventing or remedying harm, so defeating it wrongs those affected only through the harm it lets continue or risks, and where the harm's course is fixed by causes contest could not touch, reproducing the projections that defeat it adds no wrong beyond the harm | For [LEAD-097](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-097.md), the objection the argument for [CLAIM-614](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-614.md) has to meet: the instrumentalist reduction its defeater names, put in its strongest form. Procedures of complaint, hearing and review are valuable for what they prevent and repair; an error that changes nothing is, in a court's phrase, harmless. On that view the defeat of standing is wrong through the expected harm it causes, and a case whose expected harm is matched shows nothing beyond the harm. Filed so the reply has something to answer; the reply is [ARG-228](../../../record/arguments.d/ARG-228.md), which matches expected harm by construction and finds the defeat still there. Whether the objection is answered, and so goes Rejected, is the owner's call. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
